    "Super Profit = Average Profit - Normal Profit = Rs. 45,000 - Rs. 30,000 = Rs. 15,000.",
    "Goodwill = Super Profit x 100 / Normal Rate of Return = Rs. 15,000 x 100 / 10 = Rs. 1,50,000."
